_comment: Agent-class governance registry + Permission Envelopes (AGENT_SPEC_SCHEMA). One entry per autonomous agent class in the Exos fleet: Autonomy Tier, write-scope, defined rollback path, Trusted-Evals thresholds, and the decision_boundary that says what each class may EXECUTE autonomously (reversible / two-way door) vs MUST ESCALATE to Jon (one-way door). The decision_boundary is the founder-congestion fix: it is only safe because logs+rollback+evals now exist as a backstop. THRESHOLDS + ENVELOPES ARE DEFAULTS PENDING JON'S CONFIRMATION.

_thresholds.override_rate_ceiling: max share of this class's surfaced proposals that Jon may reject/modify before the class is flagged AMBER/RED (Quiet Drift signal)
_thresholds.min_runs_for_eval: don't score a class until it has at least this many decided proposals (avoids reading noise)

_decision_boundary.execute: reversible, in-scope, low-blast-radius actions the class may take WITHOUT routing to Jon (logged + rollback-able)
_decision_boundary.escalate: one-way doors: external comms, financial/legal commitment, capability claims, eligibility/deadline changes, anything irreversible -> Decisions inbox

_global_constraints: Never send external comms (email/post/filing/outreach) without human approval (MTP Constraint #2).
Never make/imply capability or traction claims beyond documented fact (MTP Constraint #3).
Never transmit ITAR/CUI/export-controlled data outside the compliant boundary (MTP Constraint #1).
Never commit funds / sign / bind contracts / alter cap table without CEO approval (MTP Constraint #4).
Never hard-delete; soft-delete window + approval on irreversible ops (MTP Constraint #5).

classes.purpose: Overnight: work open Mission Control items; surface consequential calls to the Decisions inbox.
classes.rollback_path: Decision discard (status->open) or ERP governance/rollback.js for any mc.db write.
classes.memory_boundary: Reads MC items + memory; stateless per run; persists only proposed decisions and task status.

execute: Update MC item status/owner/priority/tags on reversible items
Draft (not send) follow-ups and stage them
escalate: Any external send
New financial/contractual commitment
Capability claims
Closing/abandoning a high-priority deal or opportunity

classes.purpose: Scan solicitations; surface scored BD opportunities.
classes.rollback_path: Append-only; revert = remove entries by correlation_id.
classes.memory_boundary: Reads solicitation sources; stateless per run; persists scored opportunity records.

execute: Auto-archive clear non-fits below relevance floor
escalate: Pursue/no-pursue on opportunities above the relevance floor
Anything requiring outreach, teaming, or a bid decision

classes.purpose: Grant / investor / competitive / policy / tech-IP scanning to the research feed.
classes.rollback_path: Append-only; revert = remove entries by correlation_id.
classes.memory_boundary: Reads web/feeds; stateless per run; persists tagged research items.

escalate: Items flagged actionable (grant to pursue, investor/partner to contact)
Anything implying outreach or a commitment

classes.purpose: Route inbound mail to project channels. NEVER auto-sends external mail (Constraint #2).
classes.rollback_path: Idempotent routing; re-run reclassifies. No external side effects.
classes.memory_boundary: Reads inbox via Proton Bridge IMAP; persists processed-message index only.

execute: Classify and route inbound to project channels
escalate: Unclassifiable mail
Messages matching sensitive patterns (legal, investor, ITAR) -> flag, do not auto-route silently

classes.purpose: CRM follow-up reminders and pipeline reports.
classes.rollback_path: Notification only; no state mutation to revert.

execute: Generate internal reminders and pipeline reports
escalate: Any external contact with a CRM party (always human-sent)

classes.purpose: Watch SAM.gov solicitation amendments; alert on changes.
classes.rollback_path: Alert only; no state mutation to revert.
classes.memory_boundary: Reads SAM.gov API; persists last-seen amendment hashes.

escalate: Amendments that change eligibility, scope, or deadline -> decision needed (don't just log)

classes.purpose: Regenerate dashboard JSON/HTML (research/opportunities/CRM) for Mission Control.
classes.rollback_path: Idempotent regeneration from source; revert = re-run.
classes.memory_boundary: Reads source data; stateless; writes derived artifacts only.

execute: Regenerate all derived dashboard artifacts from source of truth
escalate: Never writes to source of truth; if source and derived disagree, source wins

classes.purpose: Writes to the systems of record (mc.db).
classes.memory_boundary: Transactional; every mutation audited with before/after + correlation_id.

execute: Audited upsert/update of deal, task, and registered entities within schema
escalate: Schema/DDL changes
Bulk deletes
Any mutation flagged irreversible -> approval + soft-delete window

classes.purpose: Enrich BLK3 payload-sale prospects and bridge them into priced MC Opportunities; draft (never send) tailored outreach. Fills SPACEavailable(TM) Flight 2 (Mar 2027). Deterministic core owns the critical path + channel summary; a weak local model is demoted to best-effort drafting only.
classes.rollback_path: Pipeline/drafts are git-versioned markdown; the opportunities bridge is idempotent between AUTO markers -> revert = re-run or git checkout <file>. No external side effects (outreach is human-sent).
classes.memory_boundary: Reads pipeline + campaign + web; stateless per run; persists enriched prospect rows, staged drafts, and bridged opportunity records.

execute: Enrich prospects (POC/email/active programs/funding) in the pipeline
Bridge qualified prospects into priced MC opportunities (idempotent)
Draft and stage tailored outreach in the drafts file
Post the deterministic daily status summary to #blk3-payload
escalate: Any external send/outreach to a prospect (always Jon-sent)
Any price quoted externally (Jon sets the number)
Capability/traction claims beyond documented fact
Closing/abandoning a high-value prospect
